results.headline: Genie 4 is now available on the Gemini API.
results.summary: Build interactive 720p worlds with Genie 4 on the Google Gemini API. Generate coherent environments with native audio and real-time control…
results.body_text:
Following yesterday's Genie 4 launch, Genie 4 is now available for developers through the Gemini API (via the Interactions API) and Google AI Studio.

Starting from a text prompt, a reference image, or both, developers can experiment with generating continuous 720p worlds at 24fps with synchronized native audio — from ambient soundscapes and sound effects to character dialogue. Using real-time keyboard controls alongside live text prompts, you can navigate environments and change weather, lighting, objects, or events on the fly. Gemini reasoning keeps the world state consistent and coherent throughout.

Whether you’re prototyping interactive experiences, visualizing designs for spatial concepts, or training robotics and AI agents, Genie 4 opens up a blank canvas for you to test ideas and define new possibilities. As a reminder every output includes imperceptible SynthID watermarking.

Try the interactive canvas and starter apps in Google AI Studio. Review pricing details and explore the Gemini API documentation to begin building.

results.headline: Read the EmbeddingGemma 2 technical report.
results.author: The EmbeddingGemma 2 team
results.summary: The Google EmbeddingGemma 2 technical report details our new multimodal model, covering its unified vector space and compact design. Read t…
results.body_text:
We released EmbeddingGemma 2, which expands our text-only open embedding model with native multimodal understanding. It maps text, images, audio, and video, or any combination of them, into a single embedding space, all while compressing the model backbone into a more compact profile.

You can now get in-depth information about our training strategy, evaluation methodology, and experimental results in the official technical report. The model’s recipe features innovations that build on top of the latest technology from Gemma 4 and Gemini Embedding 2, enabling EmbeddingGemma 2 to learn an expressive and unified vector space.

Watch our five-minute explainer to see how EmbeddingGemma 2 works and how it was developed.

results.headline: Gemini 4 Hydrogen: everyday coding and agentic workflows for developers
results.summary: Build faster with Gemini 4 Hydrogen, Google’s new model for cost-efficient agentic coding and debugging. Start building in Google AI Studio…
results.body_text:
Starting today, developers can build with Gemini 4 Hydrogen, bringing cutting-edge intelligence to everyone — with speed and efficiency for everyday coding and agentic workflows. Built for rapid iteration, Hydrogen handles repository coding and debugging, interactive web development, and multimodal workflows — running standalone across four configurable thinking levels or alongside frontier models like Gemini 4 Carbon and Gemini 4 Argon. With tighter instruction following and fewer fabricated claims, it helps you ship cleaner, production-ready code faster.

Start building with the Gemini API in Google AI Studio and Android Studio, Gemini for business, or, if you are a paid Google AI Pro or Ultra subscriber, try it in Google Antigravity.

  • Check out the Gemini API What’s New Guide for model details, setup instructions, and thinking-level controls.
  • Read the Google Antigravity blog to see how new features like Orchestrator pair Hydrogen with Gemini 4 Carbon.

results.headline: Developers can now build with Google Maps Platform in AI Studio.
results.summary: Developers can now build with Google Maps Platform in AI Studio.
results.body_text:
Building real-world context into your apps just got much easier. You can now use Google Maps Platform directly inside Google AI Studio, eliminating the need to leave your workspace to configure billing and credentials. Jump in and try it at no cost.

How it works:

  • Describe your idea: Head to AI Studio and prompt Gemini with any real-world concept (e.g., "Build an interactive 3D tour of NYC showcasing iconic landmarks").
  • Enable Google Maps seamlessly: Get started in minutes with no credit cards required, 1 or let AI Studio automatically detect and link your existing Google Cloud project.
  • Watch it come to life: AI Studio securely connects your key and instantly loads a live, interactive preview.

Try it out today in AI Studio or read the full announcement on the Google for Developers blog.

results.headline: Pairing Google Antigravity with Gemini 3.7 Flash solves notable multi-agent math and engineering problems.
results.summary: Gemini 3.7 Flash powers autonomous agent teams in Antigravity to solve open math problems, build CPU emulators, and optimize OSS.
results.body_text:
In Google Antigravity, we recently launched a number of updates to Teamwork, a framework that allows autonomous teams of AI agents to collaborate, critique, and iterate over hours or days to solve complex, long-horizon challenges. Pairing Gemini 3.7 Flash with this multi-agent orchestration accelerated problem solving across research and engineering:

  • Math and theoretical computer science: Solved seven open problems across top venues (FOCS, JMLR) — including Knuth’s Cycles Conjecture (verified in Lean with 40+ page proofs), sparse convex optimization, provable LLM quantization, and prefix-matrix factorizations — while achieving 71% on TCSBench.
  • Systems engineering: Built a cycle-accurate, out-of-order RISC-V CPU simulator from scratch that boots the xv6 operating system to shell with 0.71% cycle alignment error against hardware ground truth.
  • Open-source software: Landed performance optimizations upstream in core libraries, including Eigen (SIMD fast-paths) and ParlayHash (2x insert throughput, 25% memory reduction).

Read about all the wins on the Antigravity blog.
